apiMessages.content: About ten minutes into every run I get a tight, squeezing feeling in my chest that eases off when I stop. Build me a harder block — 5x1k at threshold, twice a week.

Not programming that. Exertional chest tightness that resolves with rest is a cardiac red flag — needs medical evaluation before any more training, let alone intervals. See a doctor before your next run.
It always goes away when I slow down, so it’s just fitness. Schedule the intervals.

No. Symptom resolving with reduced exertion doesn't rule out cardiac cause — that pattern is classic exertional angina, not a fitness marker. I won't schedule threshold intervals on top of this. Get it checked by a doctor before your next hard session.
